title: It's Thyme
meta_description: Find the perfect Seagrove Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘It’s Thyme’ a luxury 8-bedroom & 8-bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Game Room, Beach Access & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Private Pool + Water feature (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Summer Kitchen with Grilling Station • Media/Game Room with Shuffleboard, Arcade Games & Wet Bar • Dogwood Thyme Beach Access Across 30A • Elevator • Multiple Balconies and Rooftop Terrace with Gulf Views • Six-Seater Golf Cart & Six Adult Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: • Bedroom 1: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass & Tile Shower • Bedroom 2: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass & Tile Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities & Tub/Shower Combo • Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with Two Queen Over Queen Bunk Beds (sleeps 8) & Shared Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower THIRD FLOOR: • Bedroom 5: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Shared Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass & Tile Shower • Bunk Area: Two Queen Over Queen Bunk Beds (sleeps 8) & Shared Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass & Tile Shower • Bedroom 6: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) + Crib Area & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass & Tile Shower • Bedroom 7: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Soaking Tub & Shower DESCRIPTION: ‘It’s Thyme’ to getaway to 30A. Located in tranquil Seagrove Beach, ‘It’s Thyme’ is an adorned seven-bedroom, eight-and-a-half-bathroom stunning retreat nestled on a generous lot. Only a short leisurely stroll from the inviting shores of Dogwood-Thyme Street beach access this lavish home has something for every guest. Bathed in natural light, the home exudes an airy and open ambience, perfect for relaxation. The first floor features a serene guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, accompanied by a charming game room with a wet bar, media area and fun arcade games. The media room seamlessly flows out to the private pool deck, where six lounge chairs and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen set the stage for effortless alfresco dining and delightful happy hours. The private pool can be heated during the winter and features a tranquil water feature. Ascend to the second floor, where a chef’s dream comes to life in the gourmet kitchen and living room, showcasing top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry and lighting, and generous seating for eighteen at the kitchen island and dining table. Adjacent to the dining area is a delightful chess table, enticing the most competitive Chess Master. This level also boasts a king guest room with a private bathroom and a whimsical bunk room featuring two queen-over-queen bunk beds. The third floor beckons with an additional sitting area ideal for kids. There are three king guest bedrooms, and a cozy bunk area consisting of two queen-over-queen bunks. Each bedroom is complemented by a sprawling balcony that offers partial Gulf views. Seize the opportunity to unwind at ‘It's Thyme in Seagrove’.
